name: Ray Marching with Occupancy Grid Skipping
definition: A GPU-accelerated ray marching algorithm that samples along rays, optionally skipping empty space using a 3D occupancy grid and handling scene contractions.
summary: Ray Marching with Occupancy Grid Skipping is a GPU-accelerated algorithm that skips empty space using a binary occupancy grid for traversal, differing from distance map methods by using discrete voxel checks instead of continuous distance fields.
